translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content: Kuom jatend wer. Kaluwore gi sheminith

content.text: Kony ji yaye Jehova Nyasaye,
nikech joma oluoro Nyasaye koro onge;
joma jo-adiera oserumo e dier ji.
Ngʼato ka ngʼato riambo ne nyawadgi;
dhogi mohero jaro ji wuoyo gi wuond.
Mad Jehova Nyasaye ongʼad oko lep duto
ma jaro ji kod lep duto masungore;
mawacho niya, “Wabiro wuoyo kaka wahero;
kendo onge ngʼama biro tamowa.
Koso en ngʼa ma ruodhwa manyalo tamowa timo kamano?”
“Nikech dich modigo joma ok nyal
kod chur ma joma ochando churgo,
koro abiro aa malo,” Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
“Abiro ritogi e lwet joma sandogi.”
Weche Jehova Nyasaye liw,
giliw ka fedha moleny e lowo mowangʼ maliet ha,
mopwodhi ndalo abiriyo.
Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, yie iritwa maber kik gimoro ohinywa
kendo reswa e lwet joma kamago nyaka chiengʼ.
Joma timbegi richo wuotho koni gi koni
kendo gima rach ema ji puoyo.

footnotes.text: Sheminith: Ochalo ni en kit wer moro
